“

Double-click to trade karma for something useful.
Can only buy one item per day.

— In-game description

The Karmic Converter is an item that allows you to trade karma for one of three items per day. Upon use, a vendor window opens which allows you to buy an item. After buying one, the list clears until the next day. The available items change every day.

Trivia

[edit]
  • The item was initially unavailable in the Wizard's Gobbler due to technical limitations.[1] It was later added with the November 10, 2026 game update.
    • This also changed the mechanics of its offers from being a fixed rotation to likely being fully random. The old rotation can be found here and its research here.
    • The ID of the item variants offered were changed to match the containers from similar gobblers, allowing them to stack together.
